proposals_approval_recorded.name: proposals_approval_recorded
proposals_approval_recorded.value: "proposals"."status" <> 'approved' or ("proposals"."approved_at" is not null and "proposals"."approved_ip" is not null)

quote_requests_dates.name: quote_requests_dates
quote_requests_dates.value: "quote_requests"."end_date" is null or "quote_requests"."start_date" is null or "quote_requests"."end_date" >= "quote_requests"."start_date"

legal_documents_published_recorded.name: legal_documents_published_recorded
legal_documents_published_recorded.value: "legal_documents"."status" <> 'published' or ("legal_documents"."effective_at" is not null and "legal_documents"."published_by" is not null)
